capture-date.description: Request start time normalized to UTC.

entry-index.description: Zero-based index of the exchange in the source HAR log.entries array.

http-method.description: HTTP request method recorded in the HAR entry.

http-response-header.description: One archived HTTP response header represented as JSON with a lowercase name and its value.

http-status.description: Status code of the recorded HTTP response. A value of 0 indicates a missing response.

http-version.description: HTTP version reported by the HAR response.

started-date-time-raw.description: Original HAR startedDateTime value, including timezone and source precision.

target-uri.description: Original HTTP or HTTPS URL of the recorded request.

description: Metadata for an HTTP or HTTPS exchange in a HAR log, linked to the source file and corresponding page capture.
name: har-entry
